primary_evidence.document: Constitution of the Autonomous Republic of Abkhazia, consolidated 2019-11-21 through 2025-04-03
primary_evidence.observed_article_1: Article 1(1) describes the Autonomous Republic of Abkhazia as an indivisible territorial unit of Georgia; Article 1(3) says its territory may not be changed without its consent; Article 1(4) says its administrative-territorial division is determined by Georgian and Autonomous Republic legislation.
primary_evidence.applicability: Confirms the named Abkhazia feature denotes an administrative territorial entity in Georgia domestic legal texts. It does not define or validate the precise source polygon, boundary coordinates, or source capture date.

primary_evidence.document: Law of Georgia on Occupied Territories; opened consolidated 2015-07-17 through 2018-06-06

primary_evidence.applicability: Confirms the legal scope/name in that statute, not cartographic boundary equivalence, effective local control, or the source feature’s exact spatial fit.
